scope: Pre-release package qualification on hosted Windows and Linux VMs. Completion checks do not establish transcript or translation meaning.

reviewed_translation_errors: Compact Urdu rendered abductees as the invented name Aguashadans.
Compact Bengali described expressions lasting a few milliseconds as permanent.

checks: Required Rust format, lint, all-target tests, source test-name audit, documentation tests and release build
Real native translator loading and completion before the Rust checks
Four held-out recordings, Unicode paths, original transcript character-error bounds and completed English output
Both compact and quality translator loading and inference
Offline cached use, missing-model rejection, silence without large model downloads and preservation of existing reports
Desktop window opening with an Urdu speech report
Existing aircraft, URL intake, OCR and portable dependency checks
windows_runtime_fix: Native DLLs share the C++ runtime and bundle the required unmodified Visual Studio REDIST DLLs with version, hash and redistribution records. The earlier translator model-loading crash no longer occurs in the qualified package.

retained_failed_runs.reason: Windows lint rejected a Unix-only mutable command binding.
The delayed-audio test fixture depended on lavfi, which the bundled FFmpeg does not include.
Windows native translator failed fast while loading a model with separate static CRT copies across DLLs.

release_requirement: The final main revision must pass both platform gates again; published validation receipts bind each downloadable package to that exact source commit and tree.
